title: Conversation Trace Step — v4
description: v4 (2026-11-01, BPM write face): `traceEffect.resultId` accepts a **string** beside a number — an effect's object key is not always a number, and the trace must be able to name the row the write produced. Additive: the field keeps its name and its required status, a numeric id stays valid, and `additionalProperties` on `traceEffect` is already true. GET /ai/conversations/:id/trace data.steps[]. The `type` enum stays frozen — widening it breaks front-end predicates. v3 (2026-10-20, A4): `traceEffect` now declares `status` — the server-normalized lifecycle reading (`executed` / v4（2026-11-01，BPM 写面）：`traceEffect.resultId` 在数字之外接受**字符串** —— effect 的对象键不总是数字，而轨迹必须点得出这次写产出的那一行。**加性**：字段名与 required 不变，数字 id 仍然合法，`traceEffect` 的 `additionalProperties` 本就是 true。`revoked` / `revoking_external` / `revoke_failed`) that `EffectProjection.normalizeStatus` has always supplied and `decision-trace.service.ts` has always passed through, but which the schema never named. Additive: every v2 field and its semantics are unchanged, no value set moves, and the field is required because the trace always emits it (there is no "absent" reading). Source: src/ai/trace/decision-trace.service.ts. v2 (2026-10-03, T.9 F2): `outcome` gains `pending_approval` — R4 high-impact actions are referred to human approval instead of inlining a confirmation; additive for the same reason. / GET /ai/conversations/:id/trace 的 data.steps[] 元素（TraceStep）。type 枚举若扩会破坏前端判据——冻结敏感点。v3（2026-10-20，A4）：`traceEffect` 补上 `status` —— 服务端归一的生命周期读数（`executed` / `revoked` / `revoking_external` / `revoke_failed`），`EffectProjection.normalizeStatus` 一直下发、`decision-trace.service.ts` 一直原样透传，只是 schema 从未命名它。**加性**：v2 的全部字段与其语义一字未动、取值集合不变；该字段列为 required，因为轨迹恒下发它（不存在「缺席」这个读数）。来源：src/ai/trace/decision-trace.service.ts。

status.description: The projection's normalized lifecycle reading, passed through unchanged; the trace never derives a second one. / 投影归一的生命周期读数，原样透传；轨迹不自算第二套。
